notes: Hard because the bundled spec has a hard floor (C-e15286f4 masked-marker handling). The task is a 9-slice multi-format parsing pipeline with an exact TSV schema/ordering: an indentation-based tree -F parser, a lowercase-command/header QDP table parser, a mixed-encoding (json/ini/yaml) preference decoder, an address street-number-linebreak extractor, and a weighted-CNF parser whose optimal MaxSAT objective must be recomputed exactly (quantitative_correctness 3, reasoning_depth 3). The verifier re-runs parse.py on four hidden directories (hidden_case_generalization 3) that probe invalid/leap dates, blank and short tabular rows with extra columns, malformed address blocks, fifo/socket tree suffixes, empty QDP tables, uppercase masked markers, all-hard and unused-variable WCNF cases. dependent_stages 2 and tool_breadth 3 reflect the multi-file pipeline that must reconcile all inputs into one sorted structure.
